==Description==
'''Conga''' is an exclusive [[Emotes|emote]]. When performed, the player can move, and music can be heard. It is looped and other players can interact with it. The emote was made by STEALTH_NOVA.

Other players can interact with someone that is performing the '''Conga''' emote. This will cause them to also perform it and follow the player, creating a conga line.

==Trivia==
*This emote is based on [[wp:Conga line|conga]], which is a line dance.
**Specifically, it is based off the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Conga conga] taunt from ''Team Fortress 2'', especially with the fact that players can join in and the animation being very similar.
*This emote was originally listed in the in-game update log for the [[v1.9.0|Lunar Overture Update]], alongside [[Charleston]] and [[Footwork]]. However, unlike these emotes, it was never actually made obtainable.
**It was also stated to be interactable in the update log.
